'''1999 Bisley RP tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG tournament played on 4 July 1999 at Bisley. [[Rod Latham]] finished 4th of 31.<ref name="tourneys">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/tourneys.htm My Tournament Reports], Rod Latham, [[Trandosite]]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001204191500/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/tourneys.htm Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="lst11">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/lst11.htm Endor Harvest], [[Trandosite]]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010319195059/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/lst11.htm Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Date:''' 4 July 1999
* '''Site:''' Bisley
* '''Winner:''' Unknown

== Dating ==

The Light deck is dated 2 July 1999. Latham's results page has no event that day; the nearest is Bisley RP on 4 July (5–1), so it is the closest match. The Dark deck (dst11) was not preserved.
